name: Wisconsin Plastics Inc
old_description: Contract manufacturing in plastics involves design, prototyping, production, and assembly of plastic components for various industries. WPI specializes in custom solutions.
about:
Wisconsin Plastics Inc (WPI) is headquartered in Green Bay, Wisconsin. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure in the provided materials. It describes itself as an "idea company" that turns concepts into custom-manufactured products through collaboration with customers and a network of capabilities.

WPI operates as a contract manufacturer specializing in scientific molding, electromechanical assembly, and integrated product design. Its service portfolio spans project management, product design, scientific molding, electromechanical assemblies, integrated technology, distribution and fulfillment, and contract manufacturing. The company also designs and fabricates automated assembly fixtures, performs clean-room and electronic assembly, and offers UL-approved assembly, soldering, and testing. It sources and warehouses externally manufactured components and provides direct shipping via FedEx, UPS, LTL, and full-load carriers with full EDI capabilities.

The company serves defense and aerospace, medical, automotive, retail, and industrial sectors. It highlights cutting-edge design and quality procedures for demanding defense and aerospace environments, and produces sterile, biocompatible components for medical devices.

WPI emphasizes a value-based approach that aims to deliver better communication, lower costs, and shorter lead times by taking projects from consumer research through production implementation. It maintains a sustainability program that includes using regrind, recycling, energy-efficient hybrid molding machines, closed-loop water systems, and membership in the EPA's Green Supplier Network.
